description: Agent Vendors: submit a vendor as it presents itself and the identity evidence in hand: the vendor’s name, legal name, trading name, web domain, contact email, phone, postal address and registration number; and each piece of evidence with its id, its kind (a registration, a contract, an invoice, the website, the payment account, correspondence, a directory or marketplace listing, or other), where it came from, the seller name, domain, email and registration number it shows, the account holder a payment would go to and when it was read. The signed report gives the vendor with its name read without legal suffixes, its domain and its contact domain, every piece of evidence with what it shows and its status as matches, mismatch, listing_only or unread, and counts the evidence matching, mismatched, listed apart and unread, and names a vendor that is not who it claims to be: evidence naming another seller, showing another domain, paying another account holder or carrying another registration number, and a contact address on another domain; then a contact on a free-mail domain, no contact path, no domain, no legal name and no registration entry or signed contract, with the fix for each. Directory and marketplace listings are listed apart and never counted as identity evidence; a vendor with only listings behind it is unverified. This reads one vendor before a spend: an agent’s own identity record is wever_agent-identity-check, a research brief across directory, index and evidence sources is wever_counterparty-brief, an onboarding packet’s completeness and formats are wever_counterparty-onboarding-check and the buyer named on a receipt is wever_delegated-identity-check. Verdict vendor_misrepresented, identity_partial, vendor_unverified or vendor_verified. POST /api/vendor-identity-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
